issue.title: capture_with_kick_returns_before_the_clip_finishes flakes under full-suite load
issue.description: capture::r#ref::capture_with_kick_returns_before_the_clip_finishes failed once under full-suite parallel load and passed in isolation on an unchanged tree. Its 10 s wall-clock budget, and the detached ref-jobs kick it exercises, are load-sensitive.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-5k.5--2 (notes #2 and #3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) during epic bob-cli-5k; triaged by bob-cli-5k.land.

- On athena, 2026-10-07, a 21:02 `just check` run failed this test together with two completion bash readline tests. Those completion flakes are recorded on active epic bob-cli-3j, note #8.
- The 20:39 full run was green.
- The test passed when retried isolated, both on the phase tree and on a stashed clean base, so the tasks-sandbox change did not cause it.
- The failure message was not recorded.
- bob-cli-5k.land ran 2 `just check` passes on master 74c2afc (load ~76-82) with 1180/1180 CLI passing, so there was no recurrence.

What the test does (tests/cli/capture/ref.rs ~line 893, added by c9b361b / bob-cli-52.7):
- It runs `bob capture -f json <ARTICLE_URL>` with the ref-jobs kick enabled and a 20 s `sleep` web-clip adapter.
- It asserts the capture returns in under 10 s and queues one file.
- Under heavy load the capture plus detached-kick spawn may exceed the 10 s wall-clock budget, or the kick may briefly hold the call's pipes.
- The cause is unconfirmed. Next step: capture the failing assertion message (elapsed time vs. placement or queued count) under `cargo test --test cli -- --test-threads=64` with a concurrent build.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just check (full-suite parallel load on athena)

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-5k.5--2 saw this capture-kick timing test fail once in a full just check run and pass isolated on both the phase tree and a clean base; no existing bead tracks it.

payload.description: same full-suite load flake runs also failed 3j's completion timing tests (3j note #8)
